description: This file is a C header (.h) file that declares exported function prototypes for the HTTP Advanced Proxy Object within a BroadWay Service Delivery System. It includes licensing information, module description, and function declarations related to object creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization.

methods.name: HttpCreateAdvancedProxy
methods.description: Creates an instance of the HTTP Advanced Proxy object, taking context handles for container, owner, and reserved parameters.

methods.name: HttpApoCreate
methods.description: Creates the HTTP Proxy object with specified context handles.

methods.name: HttpApoRemove
methods.description: Removes the HTTP Proxy object, performing cleanup.

methods.name: HttpApoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls or registers necessary objects within the proxy object.
